purpose: Preregister a market-blind altitude challenger without modifying the frozen CFB model-selection v1 search.

baseline_contract.rule: Add exactly one preregistered altitude candidate to the existing market-blind CFB score model; do not alter the baseline feature set, target construction, residual sampler, or hyperparameter search in the same attempt.

source_contract.static_metadata_claim: Elevation is treated as venue metadata, not as a game outcome or market observation.

snapshot_contract.format: UTF-8 JSONL sorted deterministically by entity type then numeric id

feature_contract.neutral_site_rule: Use the actual game venue elevation and away-team home venue elevation; do not substitute the listed home team's home venue.

candidates.formula: one-hot bins of altitude_delta_ft using fixed cut points

candidates.rest_contract: away_rest_days must be computed only from games completed before target kickoff; missing prior-game evidence fails closed.

evaluation_contract.eligible_seasons_rule: Use only seasons in the pre-fit dataset manifest with complete PIT-eligible baseline features and bound altitude metadata; never use 2026 for fit, tuning, candidate selection, or threshold selection.

primary_metric.name: joint_score_rmse
primary_metric.selection_rule: A challenger cannot advance unless held-out joint_score_rmse is strictly lower than the unchanged baseline on the same rows.

evaluation_contract.global_guard: Reject any candidate whose altitude-subgroup diagnostic improves while overall held-out joint_score_rmse worsens or is unchanged.

attempt_accounting.consume_attempt_when: The first held-out candidate score is computed after policy and dataset/snapshot manifests are bound.
